brief: A native macOS menu bar app for screenshots, annotation and GIF recording. The name asks a question, "Can I clip?", so the mark should carry both the question and the act of capturing, and work from a 16 px menu bar icon to a Dock tile.
criteria: Success: avoids camera and aperture clichés, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, distinct in the Dock.

concepts.name: Question Frame
concepts.idea: A selection frame whose top-right corner turns into a question mark: Can I clip?
rationale: Holds the whole name in one shape: the crop frame is the clip, the hook is the question
Built from one stroke, one corner radius and one dot, so the wordmark grows from the same parts
A small-size cut keeps the counter and dot gap open in the 16 px menu bar
Clip Yellow is rare in the Dock and reads as the annotation highlighter

recommendation: Ship Question Frame in Ink on light surfaces, Clip Yellow on dark, and Ink on a Clip Yellow tile for the app icon.
next_steps: Drop the AppIcon and MenuBarIcon sets into the Xcode asset catalog
Use the reversed artwork on dark surfaces only
Run a professional trademark search before public launch
